option_relations.rationale: Peritoneal carcinomatosis secondary to ovarian cancer is a specific manifestation of metastatic ovarian cancer.
Metastatic high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma is a more specific type of metastatic ovarian cancer.
Recurrent Ovarian Serous Adenocarcinoma with Metastatic Disease is clinically equivalent to Metastatic Ovarian Cancer, as the vignette describes recurrence and metastasis.

Recurrent stage IIIC papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary with BRCA1-positive somatic mutation is a more specific and detailed description of metastatic ovarian cancer, including its stage, histology, and genetic mutation.
